status: Native major Vanishing Point workflow implemented and tested. Full F05/Photoshop parity remains open.
scope: Saved perspective planes and connected planes, perspective paste/clone/brush, native preview workspace, local/document Undo, native32 persistence and shared Photato API.

primary_references.scope: Perspective workspace and tool families. Secondary marquee, measurement and healing remain open.
Four-corner planes, related planes and angles, retained document planes.
Brush/clone controls and source alignment. Multi-surface wrapping and healing are not implemented.

primary_references.finding: No dedicated Vanishing Point operation. Unqualified actionJSON remains explicitly unsupported.

implementation_choices: Swift camera inference, projective plane mapping and related-plane Rodrigues rotation reuse the original Rust approach; brush painting extends the upstream paste/clone commands.

Sequential draft operations composite over the original visible sample; a clone stroke freezes its source. Source-layer paste uses raw raster pixels, matching the API; clipboard import performs color conversion.
Renderer Float32 samples convert to the document depth at the prepared-edit boundary. Selection, affine target placement and image/transparency locks apply, with optional new-layer output.
Saved canonical focal/center/root planes follow global canvas/path transforms. Related planes retain their links. Nonuniform camera recalibration remains unqualified.
Prepared edits are cancellable and reject stale source documents before commit. One command retains plane metadata and pixels together; local workspace undo is separate from document history.

photato_api.state: Strict settings/operation schemas; document and workspace saved settings plus resolved plane corners/metric dimensions; active tool, selection, preview/rendering, navigation and local history availability. Existing revision/busy/sharing protections apply.

adobe_api.scope: No invented Adobe route. Unqualified Vanishing Point actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB plane metadata reject. Rendered raster export remains available.

tests.independent_evidence: Analytical 3D camera/focal/aspect/perpendicular shared-edge checks, all-depth paste/clone/brush and clipping, selections/locks/transforms/history/cancellation/invalid atomicity/native32, native controllers and API equality/busy/stale/schema guards. Not independent Photoshop pixels.
tests.offscreen_limit: Inspected pixels, perspective brush/grid and native control arrangement. AppKit button/picker capture incomplete offscreen; no live visual/pointer qualification.

limitations: Perspective marquee/floating selections/cut, measurement, healing modes and multi-surface stroke wrapping are absent. Full F05 remains open.
No recorded Actions integration for this prepared composite operation; playback/recording reports unsupported rather than silently omitting it. Direct desktop and API are implemented.
Target must be an ordinary raster layer. Native workspace admission currently needs an unlocked image target even when new-layer output would be possible in the engine/API.

32 planes,256 operations,16,384 supplied points,4,096 per stroke,128MiB embedded sources,8,388,608 canvas/target pixels and134,217,728 raster visits. Larger document performance remains open; API sharing limits apply separately.
Exact Adobe pixels, full color-mode matrix, complete grid/keyboard/context interactions and nonuniform transformed-camera recalibration are unqualified.
Native32 preserves planes. Adobe PSD/PSB plane metadata and .vpe interchange are unsupported; explicit save guards prevent silent metadata loss.
Latest desktop evidence remains locked. No re-probe/bypass. Live UI, physical Intel and macOS14/26 validation remain open; current-host tests and universal builds do not prove these gates.
next: B01 major painting workflow: native Brush Settings, custom tips/dynamics and reusable presets with canvas/API/history integration. Defer exact kernels and cosmetic refinement.
qualification: All117 focused Debug and1816 full optimized tests pass. The universal macOS14+ package verifies.

measurement_reference_735.reference: Photoshop 27.2.0 on three owned checkerboard PSDs using front-facing and independent angled planes
measurement_reference_735.geometry: Double-click adds plane dimensions. An independent root retains its scale when a different root is calibrated.
measurement_reference_735.exactPreservation: The original measurement resource payloads survived three unchanged Adobe PSD re-exports.
measurement_reference_735.editability: Photato-generated PSD and PSB reopened in Photoshop at grid spacing 20 with editable lengths. Photoshop showed 40.01 and 30.01 for Photato's 40 and 30.
measurement_reference_735.angles: Photoshop shows angle labels near the initial line endpoints. Photato exposes lengths and endpoint constraints. Angle display and annotation output remain open.
measurement_reference_735.remaining: The angled Photoshop horizontal reading was 41.07 compared with 41.2970 in Photato. Complex calibration, raster annotation, DXF/3DS, physical Photato input and complete output fidelity remain open.

measurement_annotations_736.reference: Photoshop 27.2.0 on the owned front-facing checkerboard and the existing two-plane comparison
measurement_annotations_736.verifiedUI: Independent horizontal and vertical labels were 0° and 90°. Two perpendicular lines added together showed 90° at their shared corner.
measurement_annotations_736.rasterCapture: The filter window disappeared on both activation attempts while the document menus and Save became unavailable. No Adobe raster was captured.
measurement_annotations_736.photato: Apply can rasterize strokes, endpoints, length and angle labels in document space, keeping editable measurements. The native editor and authenticated API share one output path with selection and Undo.
measurement_annotations_736.remaining: Exact glyphs, colors, raster pixel equivalence, more complex angular labels and CAD exchange remain unqualified.
measurement_annotations_736.photatoReopen: Photoshop opened the Photato PSD with visible ruler marks on a separate raster, and showed the original linked editable measurements on the Photato PSB.

textured_scene_export_737.reference: Live Photoshop 27.2.0 on two owned 1600 × 1200 PSDs
textured_scene_export_737.referenceOutput: Each Adobe 3DS file had a companion VPE, a camera, and a textured two-triangle mesh for each plane. Both outputs referenced the same PNGs.

alignedSquareTextureComparison.observation: Adobe's sampled first row and column were opaque white. Tested interior rows showed a lower mean color error when compared one column to the left in Photato.

textured_scene_export_737.independentChecks: Blender 5.2 and its official 3DS extension 3.0.2 opened both Adobe and both Photato 3DS exports. A separate chunk and XML reader checked the 3DS and VPE geometry, camera and textures.
textured_scene_export_737.outputDelivery: The native Vanishing Point editor writes a new scene folder. The authenticated Photato command vanishingPoint.export returns a ZIP of saved planes and the visible composite.
textured_scene_export_737.remaining: DXF was absent in the two installed menus checked. Exact Adobe camera, world scale, texture pixels, physical save-panel interaction, and After Effects import remain unqualified.

editable_right_angle_hinge_740.reference: Photoshop 2026 27.2.0 on an owned 1200 × 900 RGB8 two-wall PSD.
editable_right_angle_hinge_740.remaining: Canonical encoding of newly authored angles, exact Marquee placement and sampling on the corrected guide, other camera configurations and multi-surface strokes.

editable_hinge_angles_741.reference: Photoshop 2026 27.2.0 on the same owned 1200 × 900 RGB8 two-wall artwork as checkpoint 740.
editable_hinge_angles_741.roundTrips: Each measured PSD and PSB retained 3,240,000 merged RGB bytes. Unedited copies retain the original perspective record.
editable_hinge_angles_741.remaining: Additional seam orientations, exact calibration for guides with parallel rays, the full range of scene geometry and raster sampling across linked planes.

stroke_marquee_744.reference: Photoshop 2026 27.2.0 with the owned tilted hinge and a separate Adobe-authored rectangular control.
stroke_marquee_744.observed: Marquee double-click selected the tilted left face. Switching to Brush showed Diameter 100, Hardness 50, Opacity 100 and Heal Off. Photoshop exited at the start of the drag. The separate single-plane control returned to Home on the first Brush dab.
stroke_marquee_744.photato: All eight native replays stayed within their projected selections. Brush, Stamp and healed Brush reached both faces with stroke wrapping enabled. Stamp sampled outside the selection.
stroke_marquee_744.remaining: Independent Adobe stroke pixels, exact seam and selection edge coverage, and Shift-constrained Brush and Stamp.

linked_brush_stamp_743.reference: Photoshop 2026 on the owned 1200 × 900 tilted-camera guide. This checkpoint also uses the earlier two-wall guide.
linked_brush_stamp_743.verifiedMenu: Allow Multi-surface Operations and Clip Operations to Surface Edges were both checked in the Photoshop Vanishing Point menu.
linked_brush_stamp_743.photato: The controls share linked Brush, Stamp and Marquee geometry. Brush and Stamp keep coverage and aligned sampling across the hinge. The API opts into wrapping per stroke.
linked_brush_stamp_743.remaining: The Photoshop Filter menu went unavailable before the stroke capture. Exact color, dab spacing, edge coverage, keyboard-modified strokes and physical Photoshop comparisons remain open.

marquee_donor_interpolation_742.reference: Photoshop 2026 27.2.0 on independent synthetic stripe and dot channels under the corrected 90-degree guide, plus the prior two-wall captures.
marquee_donor_interpolation_742.gesture: Float the entire selected face, then move by six Shift-arrow presses with opacity 100% and Heal Off. The two impulse captures use Feather 0.
marquee_donor_interpolation_742.sampling: The Photoshop impulse rasters contain overshoot and undershoot. Of the four cubic and noncubic alternatives compared against Catmull–Rom, none had lower held-out donor error on either direction.
marquee_donor_interpolation_742.photato: Bicubic donor sampling improves full-support mean RGB error on all five replays. The left-to-right impulse receiving region regresses from 7.197 to 7.478 RGB levels.
marquee_donor_interpolation_742.remaining: Exact donor position and channel rounding, projected edge coverage, the held Source drag, other interpolation conditions and higher-depth Photoshop captures.

connected_marquee_739.reference: Installed Photoshop 2026 and the owned 1,200 × 900 two-wall RGB8 fixture.
connected_marquee_739.gesture: Double-click on the left plane, Option–Command–T, twelve Shift–Right keystrokes, Apply and Save As PSD. Feather 1, Opacity 100%, Heal Off.
connected_marquee_739.remaining: Rectified scale across the hinge, direct held marquee creation, Source drag, Feather 0 and pixel equivalence.

perspective_marquee_738.reference: Installed Photoshop 2026 on an owned 1200 × 900 RGB8 puzzle grid
perspective_marquee_738.recordedGesture: Double-click Create Plane, M, double-click inside the plane, Option–Command–T, Shift–Right twice, Shift–Down once, Apply, Save As PSD.
perspective_marquee_738.nativeReplay: The exact screen-aligned plane and the plane imported from Photoshop produced identical Photato PNGs.

pixelDifference.cleanInterior: From document x=24 and y=14 through the right and lower image edges, the Photato samples matched the integer-shifted donor. The Adobe samples were equal or one 8-bit level lower. A larger mismatch remains along the feather fringe.

perspective_marquee_738.remaining: Direct Adobe Source drag, per-feather and per-depth comparisons, moving across a connected hinge, multi-face marquee wrapping, pointer transform handles and exact final pixels.
